description: Add the unique index that makes REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY legal on house.room_value.
rationale: Split from 0063 rather than bundled with it: pg_laswell measures the real catalog, and house.room_value is not in it until 0063 commits. Without this index every refresh takes AccessExclusiveLock and the rollup is unreadable while it runs.

intents.name: room_value_room_id_key
intents.comment: Unique on the grouping key. Required by REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY, which is the only reason this index exists.
